title: Isoelectric and acid protein-recovery evidence for green biomass extracts

REC-001.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY); see publisher article license statement
REC-001.applicability: Grass-clover cleared juice; reports precipitated total N relative to incoming cleared-juice total N, not a pure soluble-protein recovery fraction.
REC-001.conversion_method: Identity as reported (0.34 fraction of N). Conversion to protein recovery requires measured N speciation; no conversion applied.
REC-001.uncertainty: No SD or uncertainty interval reported for this comparison.
REC-001.runtime_mapping: Optional PR1 literature-default candidate only. GreenHub applies this N-basis value to its soluble-protein pool; this denominator mismatch remains an explicit proxy limitation and requires project-specific N-speciation validation.

REC-002.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY); see publisher article license statement
REC-002.applicability: Ryegrass juice; total N recovery includes both retained fibre fraction and protein concentrate.
REC-002.conversion_method: Identity as reported (0.70 fraction of juice N); not a precipitation-only or protein-product recovery fraction.
REC-002.uncertainty: No uncertainty interval reported for this table value.
REC-002.runtime_mapping: Evidence record only; blocked from direct precipitation-efficiency mapping because the boundary includes N in the fibre fraction.

REC-003.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY); see publisher article license statement
REC-003.applicability: Red-clover juice; total N recovery includes both retained fibre fraction and protein concentrate; not roadside grass.
REC-003.conversion_method: Identity as reported (0.77 fraction of juice N); not a precipitation-only or protein-product recovery fraction.
REC-003.uncertainty: No uncertainty interval reported for this table value.
REC-003.runtime_mapping: Evidence record only; blocked from direct precipitation-efficiency mapping because material and route boundary differ.

REC-004.license: Publisher terms; reuse license not independently verified
REC-004.applicability: Alfalfa extract; reported 30% protein recovery for acid precipitation. Not roadside grass and not equivalent to a fraction of GreenHub's soluble-protein pool without basis reconciliation.
REC-004.conversion_method: Identity as reported (0.30); no cross-feedstock conversion applied.
REC-004.uncertainty: No uncertainty interval reported in the abstract.
REC-004.runtime_mapping: Dynamic screening proxy only; retain alfalfa transferability warning.
